_comment: Declared inputTokens resolved to the character length that produces EXACTLY that many tokens, measured inside the serving image. Regenerate with hack/resolve-input-lengths.sh whenever the tokenizer revision, the chat template or the prompt corpus changes -- each is recorded below and each changes every number here.
_rule: Several character lengths give the same token count, so the recorded one is the SMALLEST: the fewest bytes on the wire for the declared count. allMatches keeps the rest so the choice is visible rather than implied.
_searchNote: The token count is not monotone in the character count -- decreasesInWindow records how often it fell inside each sweep. A binary search would step over answers that exist, so the window is swept exhaustively. The window comes from an affine fit to the three calibration points and is only a search initializer; acceptance is the exact measured count.
